about: R2-SOUND (design_docs/planned/r2/sound.md §D1): one row per cue. volume_db sets the level; bands (RMS dBFS over the active span, at default settings) are what make sound-check holds each bus to; a row's own band overrides its bus's.

cues.visual: ambient: the spire is always there; its light is on screen
cues.about: The spire's constant hum (ship-structure.md), at the mast from S1.
cues.name: The spire's hum
cues.when: Always, on the bridge (from S1 it sits at the mast).
cues.listen_for: It should be felt more than heard: low, slow, with a gentle beat every 4 s. Is it calm enough to forget after a minute, yet missed if it stopped?

cues.visual: ambient: the Archive's state is hidden by design (Memory Health is not a visible metric)
cues.about: The spire's longer beat with a slight grit, under the hum; it follows archive_degradation = 1 - Memory Health/100 (D-108). Silent while the sim does not emit Memory Health.
cues.name: The spire's degradation layer (mid)
cues.when: Always on the bridge, louder as the Archive's Memory Health falls (silent while it is intact).
cues.listen_for: A second, much slower beat (one cycle in 32 s) with a slight grit under the hum. Heard in the three 'degradation' mixes.

cues.visual: ambient: the Archive's state is hidden by design (Memory Health is not a visible metric)
cues.about: The badly degraded spire layer: the long beat roughened, wavering and gritty; it takes over as Memory Health becomes critical (D-108).
cues.name: The spire's degradation layer (bad)
cues.when: On the bridge once the Archive's Memory Health is low (below about 40).
cues.listen_for: Wavering, gritty, with a tone that does not belong. It should feel wrong without being loud.

cues.visual: ambient: room tone carries no information
cues.about: Air and structure under the bridge dome, barely there (v2, D-108; 6 dB lower, D-112).
cues.name: Bridge room tone
cues.when: Always, on the bridge.
cues.listen_for: Barely there: a soft low body of air under the hum, 6 dB lower than the last listen. It should never be what you notice.

cues.visual: ambient: interface feedback for a visible press
cues.about: An interface click.
cues.name: Interface click
cues.when: Pressing a button or a key on a panel.
cues.listen_for: Short and dry; should never be annoying after a hundred presses.

cues.visual: ambient: interface feedback for a visible close
cues.about: Back or cancel.
cues.name: Interface back
cues.when: Closing or cancelling a panel.
cues.listen_for: A click that falls; clearly 'back' next to the click.

cues.visual: ambient: interface feedback for a visible confirm
cues.about: Confirm.
cues.name: Interface confirm
cues.when: Confirming a choice on a panel.
cues.listen_for: Two quick tones up a fourth; clearly 'yes' but not cheerful.

cues.visual: ambient: the console close-up is on screen
cues.about: A console wakes (the zoom in): latch, thunk, servo, settle (v2, D-108).
cues.name: Console wakes
cues.when: Stepping up to a console (the close-up zooms in).
cues.listen_for: A latch, a soft low thunk and a fluttering servo: a precise old machine, not a toy. Compare with the v1 file.

cues.visual: ambient: the console close-up closes on screen
cues.about: A console sleeps (the zoom out): the servo closes, the latch settles (v2, D-108).
cues.name: Console sleeps
cues.when: Stepping back from a console.
cues.listen_for: The servo closing down and settling; nothing rises.

cues.visual: ambient: the hold-to-confirm ring fills on screen
cues.about: Holding to commit; stops on release (S2).
cues.name: Holding to commit
cues.when: While you hold the commit key (1.5 s).
cues.listen_for: A tone rising with the hold; in game it stops if you let go.

cues.about: The sim accepted the commit: one sealing chord.
cues.name: The commit is sealed
cues.when: The sim accepts the commit: the voyage is now irreversible.
cues.listen_for: One low open chord that settles. Final, weighty, not triumphant (no fanfare: the game doesn't judge).

cues.about: Boost: lower and richer, beating partials and an opening noise band; no rumble (the teacup rule) (v2, D-108).
cues.name: Drive: boost
cues.when: The ship starts boosting toward cruise speed.
cues.listen_for: Lower and thicker than v1: several voices beating slowly and air opening up as the ship accelerates. Nothing below 200 Hz, nothing you would feel.

cues.about: Cruise: the drive settles low and falls silent (v2, D-108).
cues.name: Drive: falls silent
cues.when: The boost ends and the ship coasts.
cues.listen_for: The drive settling down and closing off until only the hum and the room are left.

cues.about: Brake: falling, rougher than the boost (v2, D-108).
cues.name: Drive: brake
cues.when: The ship starts braking.
cues.listen_for: The boost's mirror, falling, and rougher: voices rubbing, faster beats, more air and a little grit.

cues.visual: ambient: the turn is on screen (the body swings to 30 degrees off the bow)
cues.about: A navigation tone while the ship turns at a stop; no hiss (S2 wires the tour's signal).
cues.name: Stop: the ship turns
cues.when: At a guided stop, while the ship turns the body 30 degrees off the bow.
cues.listen_for: A soft navigation tone with a slight flutter. No thruster hiss: nothing leaves the bubble but light.

cues.visual: ambient: each tick matches a flash on the dome (interior/dust_flash.gd)
cues.about: The dust counter; one tick per drawn grain, dead time in impact ship time (S2).
cues.name: Dust counter tick
cues.when: Each dust grain that flashes on the dome (the counter at the helm).
cues.listen_for: One dry tick; imagine it faster at speed in a warm cloud, sparse in the hot bubble, like a Geiger counter.

cues.about: Arrival: an understated suspended chord (v2, D-108).
cues.name: Arrival chime
cues.when: The ship arrives at its destination.
cues.listen_for: Understated and suspended, in commit_seal's mood: it tells you that you've arrived without celebrating.

cues.visual: ambient: the reply appears on the terminal
cues.about: The Archive's reply is ready: a small breathing figure (v2, D-108).
cues.name: The Archive's reply is ready
cues.when: The Archive's answer appears at its terminal.
cues.listen_for: A small breathing three-note figure with a glassy shimmer: more character than v1, still soft and in-world.

cues.about: A plan meets the drive's hold limit: an alert, not an alarm.
cues.name: Hold limit
cues.when: A plan meets the drive's hold limit.
cues.listen_for: Two soft pulses: an alert, not an alarm.

cues.visual: ambient: the walk is on screen
cues.about: A step felt more than heard at each of the captain's foot contacts (CA0 foot_down), v4 after D-123 (v3 'still sound aggressive ... not banging in the skull'): under the hum, dark, no transient; level jitter per step and every other foot softer.
cues.name: Footsteps on the bridge
cues.when: Each time the captain's foot touches the deck (CA0's foot_down).
cues.listen_for: Barely noticed: a soft, dark padding under the spire's hum and the room, rounded with no hit, pleasant after hundreds of steps; never a metronome.

cues.visual: ambient: interface feedback for a visible press
cues.about: A key press at a console (ShipConsoles.used).
cues.name: Console key
cues.when: Using a console's action.
cues.listen_for: The interface click, a little quieter, at the console.

cues.visual: ambient: the lift's doors and motion are on screen
cues.about: The lift's latch and its motor spinning up.
cues.name: Lift: start
cues.when: The lift platform starts moving between levels.
cues.listen_for: A latch, then the motor winding up; mechanical, not sci-fi.

cues.visual: ambient: the lift's motion is on screen
cues.about: The lift's motor while it travels (a loop riding with the platform).
cues.name: Lift: running
cues.when: While the platform travels.
cues.listen_for: A steady low motor with a slight flutter; it should move with the platform.

cues.visual: ambient: the arrival is on screen
cues.about: The platform settles; one old brass bell.
cues.name: Lift: arrive
cues.when: The platform reaches its level.
cues.listen_for: A soft clunk and a single low bell, restrained like the commit chord.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, family. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: family
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: A warm room of voices, never words: you can't make out what anyone says, only that they are there.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, the house and the valley. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: the house and the valley
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: Wind in leaves over a soft garden air. Outdoors, quiet.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, the town. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: the town
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: A street: voices and feet, traffic far off. Busy but distant.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, the world. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: the world
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: A big crowd far away, rising and falling. Neither happy nor angry.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, science and space. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: science and space
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: A lab: a low carrier, a fan, one slow pulsing tone. Calm machines.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, the sky over home. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: the sky over home
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: Night air and crickets.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, the torrent of weeks. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: the torrent of weeks
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: Home racing past: a babble with tunes and bells twittering through it. It should feel like too much to follow.

cues.about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home at the comms receiver, no signal. Its pitch_scale follows the Earth rate's band (data/ui/comms_feed.json): slowed and deepened flying away, sped up and raised turning for home. Compressed, not physical.
cues.name: Home: no signal
cues.when: The comms station is open and Earth's feed shows this kind of week.
cues.listen_for: A faint receiver hiss. Lower than any bed; the silence of being out of Earth's beam.

cues.about: EL3b.7 accent over the bed: a tune from the next room. Repeats at the band's interval stretched by its pitch, so slowed home is slower in time too.
cues.name: Home accent: a tune from the next room
cues.when: Now and then over its bed, while the comms station is open.
cues.listen_for: Six soft music-box notes, calm and a little wistful, not jolly.

cues.about: EL3b.7 accent over the bed: birds in the garden. Repeats at the band's interval stretched by its pitch, so slowed home is slower in time too.
cues.name: Home accent: birds in the garden
cues.when: Now and then over its bed, while the comms station is open.
cues.listen_for: Two short phrases of chirps.

cues.about: EL3b.7 accent over the bed: the town's bells. Repeats at the band's interval stretched by its pitch, so slowed home is slower in time too.
cues.name: Home accent: the town's bells
cues.when: Now and then over its bed, while the comms station is open.
cues.listen_for: Two bell strikes across the roofs, the second lower.

cues.about: EL3b.7 accent over the bed: the crowd swells. Repeats at the band's interval stretched by its pitch, so slowed home is slower in time too.
cues.name: Home accent: the crowd swells
cues.when: Now and then over its bed, while the comms station is open.
cues.listen_for: The far crowd rises and settles: an event, not a reaction to you.

cues.about: EL3b.7 accent over the bed: a time signal. Repeats at the band's interval stretched by its pitch, so slowed home is slower in time too.
cues.name: Home accent: a time signal
cues.when: Now and then over its bed, while the comms station is open.
cues.listen_for: Five short pips and a long one, like the radio before the news or a launch. Slowed, they are seconds apart; sped up, a quick patter.
